entries.title: Psalms 51:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.>> Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

entries.title: Psalms 51:2
segments: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 51:3
segments: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:4
segments: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.

entries.title: Psalms 51:5
segments: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:6
segments: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 51:7
segments: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

entries.title: Psalms 51:8
segments: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 51:9
segments: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 51:10
segments: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:11
segments: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:12
segments: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 51:13
segments: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 51:14
segments: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; [And] my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 51:15
segments: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:16
segments: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

entries.title: Psalms 51:17
segments: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:18
segments: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 51:19
segments: Then will thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and in whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
